$comment: Non-npm components shipped by realvirtual WEB (plan-544 F5, Phase 0 inventory 2026-10-03). An entry is listed in the notices when one of its `match` POSIX globs matches a bundle module id, an emitted asset name or a file of the public dir (prefixed public/). `licenseFile` is relative to this folder. Mirrored to the public repository: no private package names here.

components.name: occt-import-js
notes: Repository: https://github.com/kovacsv/occt-import-js (release 0.0.23). The WebAssembly module contains Open CASCADE Technology (https://dev.opencascade.org), LGPL-2.1-only WITH OCCT-exception-1.0.

Shipped as two separate, loose files in the build output: occt/occt-import-js.js (JavaScript glue) and occt/occt-import-js.wasm (OpenCascade compiled to WebAssembly). They are not bundled into any realvirtual chunk; the STEP-import worker loads them at runtime from <deploy base>/occt/.

To replace the library, put an interface-compatible occt-import-js.js and occt-import-js.wasm (for example a self-built or newer occt-import-js release) at the same names in the occt/ folder of the deployment.

MODIFIED by realvirtual GmbH (memory limit patch, scripts/patch-occt-memory.mjs): the WebAssembly memory section's maximum is raised from 32768 to 65536 pages and the glue's getHeapMax() from 2147483648 to 4294967296 bytes (2 GB -> 4 GB heap ceiling). No other byte is changed; the unmodified files are those of the npm release named above.
